title: Vrouwenloonwijzer 2000-2001 - VLW 2000-2001
authors: Tijdens, K.G., Fac. Economische Wetenschappen, Universiteit van Amsterdam
contributors: Dr. K. Tijdens, AIAS, Universiteit van Amsterdam (depositor)
descriptions: Survey among Dutch working women. The questionnaire contains six clusters of questions: A. profession and industry, B. the organisation, C. employment record, D. working hours, E. employment contract and salary, and F. personal questions, including gender, ethnicity, and family formation. Each cluster ends with a set of attitude items. The survey was initiated in order to establish the (Women's) Wage Indicator
